name: Reflowable e-book file
definition: a book package whose text reflows to the screen [EPUB; MOBI; AZW3; KFX; FB2; .ibook]

name: Fixed-layout e-book or document file
definition: a file that keeps a fixed page [PDF; DjVu; Apabi .xeb, .ceb]

name: Image-sequence book file
definition: a comic or book held as a packed sequence of page images [CBZ; CBR; CB7; CBT; CBA]

name: Plain and rich text file
definition: a bare text or word-processor file with no e-book package [TXT; RTF; DOC; DOCX]

name: Digital score file
definition: a music score held as a file

name: Digital music file
definition: music held as an audio file [MP3; AAC; Ogg Vorbis; FLAC; ALAC; WMA Lossless; WAV; AIFF; DSD]

name: Audiobook file
definition: a book read aloud, held as a file or file set [M4B; MP3 file set; AA; AAX; AAXC]

name: Podcast episode file
definition: an episode of a podcast held as a file

name: Digital video
definition: film, TV, home video or video artwork held as a file or a locker entitlement [MP4; MOV; MKV; or no file held]

name: Camera raw photo file [DNG; NEF; CRW; ARW; IIQ]
Lossless raster image file [TIFF; PNG; JPEG 2000; GIF]
Digital font
definition: a typeface family held as font files under a licence [the typeface family]

name: Design template file
definition: a layout file to be filled or adapted [PSDT; AIT; INDT; Canva template; a PSD sold as a template; a PDF sewing or knitting pattern]

name: Brush pack
definition: brushes for a drawing or painting program

name: Background, texture and frame pack
definition: image materials for use in making other work

name: Digital planner
definition: a planner held as a file

name: Audio sample pack or instrument library [Kontakt library]
Preset or LUT pack [Lightroom preset; synth preset]
AI model file (model weights held as a file)
Character outfit or skin [Fortnite Outfit; CS2 Agent]
Avatar accessory [Back Bling; Shoes; CS2 Gloves; Banner]
Weapon skin [CS2 pistol, rifle and knife finishes]
Tool and traversal skin [Pickaxe; Glider; Skydiving Trails; Car Trail]
In-game sticker or charm [CS2 Sticker; CS2 Charm; Patch]
Music kit or lobby music [CS2 Music Kit; Lobby Music]
Messaging sticker pack [LINE stickers; Telegram stickers]
Loot container [CS2 Weapon Case; Sticker Capsule; Steam Booster Pack]
Platform trading card [Steam Trading Card; foil is a style variant]
Badge or pin [Steam Badge; CS2 Pin]
Eligibility-restricted domain name [CO.JP, AC.JP, ED.JP, GO.JP; sponsored gTLD such as .asia]
